messages:
lina: Quick heads — I'm opening a tiny PR to tidy the starter sandbox credential examples. Main changes: switch from RAW_TOKEN env to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add a brief token-helper mention, and fix a broken KMS link. PTAL: https://redwood.infer/docs/sandbox-auth (old link)

trevor: Nice. Can you paste the new snippets inline here so I can skim before reviewing the PR?

lina: Sure — updated examples in the PR. Copy-paste snapshots: 

Bash (local):
```bash
# local dev
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk.dev-xxxxxxxx"
# quick curl smoke
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate"
```

Docker (minimal):
```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY --rm my-starter:latest
```

Node (example):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

Also added a one-line .env loader note for novices and a pointer to the token-helper CLI.

sam: Small nit: please be consistent with the env var name (REDWOOD_API_KEY) across snippets. Also add a note suggesting dotenv or direnv for local dev. And recommend `npx redwood-token-helper login` for shorter live-credential onboarding.

lina: Good catches — I standardized the var and added: `# optional: npx redwood-token-helper login` in the quickstart.

anya: Heads-up: the Docker snippet used to require `--network=host` for the lab infra, but it's optional; I left a parenthetical. Also fixed the KMS link — it should point to /security/kms, not /kms. I pushed a tiny commit to the branch.

mike: DocsBot flagged an unclosed code fence in the markdown preview (line ~23). Also we should include a short migration blurb for teams moving from SDK-5 auth pattern to SDK-7 (env var name + client constructor change).

lina: Thanks — fixed the fence and added a 2-sentence migration note. Updated the PR description to call out backporting to v2 branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

trevor: Reviewing now. Can you add an explicit curl e2e smoke instruction (one-liner) so support can quickly verify a workspace? Something like the bash curl above is perfect.

Deploybot: deploy preview created for PR #4821 — https://deploy-preview--4821.redwood.dev — build checks passing :white_check_mark:

lina: Perfect, thanks all. I'll merge after Trevor gives a quick thumbs. Will backport to the release branch and follow up with a micro changelog entry.

trevor: LGTM pending one tiny wording tweak. Will approve in a few. :+1:
